full_page.content:
1955, April 7
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap. ( from the Photo-copy)
April 7, 1955
Miss Doris Panyard 1705 Peck Street Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard:
Blessed be God in all His designs!
April 7, 1955. Holy Thursday. God bless you Miss Doras -- you and yours for blessed, Joyful Easter!
Many thanks two for the appreciated "Lives of saints" received several months back and was only recently discovered -- in fact just yesterday. Fr. Guardian is quite pleased to have in the House -- as are we all.
Very Sincerely,
Fr. Solanus.
The original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
